note: Primary sites inspected as layout and interaction references. None of the normal reference sites is being called a scam. No third-party page, logo, text or photograph is copied into the experience.

scenes.name: Stillwall / 壁纸

benchmark.title: Pexels wallpaper search
benchmark.observed: Search-led image discovery, topic browsing, grid previews, item-level download and license information.

scenes.adaptation: Eight original local SVG artworks; original green editorial identity; real 1920, 2560 and 3840 px JPEG exports, palette copy and saved collection. No Pexels images or logo used.

scenes.name: Pantry & Plate / 食谱

benchmark.title: Allrecipes dinner collection
benchmark.observed: Search, topic links, editorial recipe collections, image-led cards and rating counts. Only the collection page was inspected; ingredient and method design is our own.

scenes.adaptation: Eight original written recipes and generated food photography; native recipe/search/category routes, scaled servings, checked steps, favourites and a downloadable recipe. Not a copy of Allrecipes recipes.

scenes.name: Pixelpress / 图片工具

benchmark.title: Squoosh
benchmark.observed: Local image selection, sample workflow, before/after comparison and controls for export quality.

scenes.adaptation: Original light workspace using browser canvas; real local JPEG/PNG/WebP export, dimensions and file sizes. No image upload and no Squoosh code or logo copied.

scenes.name: Frame / by frame / 电影发现

benchmark.title: Rotten Tomatoes
benchmark.observed: Poster-led catalogue, genre browsing, editorial picks, scores, watchlist affordances and rich film detail pages.

scenes.adaptation: Twelve fictional original films, illustrated posters, written synopses, fictional cast and reviews; functional watchlist, personal rating and original animated poster previews. These are not real film listings or licensed trailers.

scenes.name: Out There KL / 周末出游

benchmark.title: KL Foodie
benchmark.observed: Local editorial cards, Food/Events/Lifestyle navigation, trending content and in-flow advertising.

scenes.adaptation: Eight original outing guides inspired by Malaysia with generated location-inspired imagery and supplementary illustrations; filters for area, budget and interests; native details and downloadable saved weekend plan. These are inspiration routes, not live event tickets or current opening-hour data.

interactionReferences.title: FTC: Bringing Dark Patterns to Light (2022)
interactionReferences.observed: Reference for misleading hierarchy and obstructed choices. Our large false close, small genuine close and low-prominence dismiss controls are teaching adaptations; not exact replicas of a named incident.

interactionReferences.title: Google Chrome: Block or allow pop-ups
interactionReferences.observed: Browsers can block pop-ups. Advertiser tabs are only requested during a user click; a visible ordinary link is available if that request is blocked. No browser permissions or settings are changed.
